title: Vegetable and Chickpea Roast
description: A baked loaf of mashed chickpeas, grated carrot and courgette, cheese and breadcrumbs, similar to a vegetarian meatloaf.

ingredients.text: 2 x 400g tins chickpeas, rinsed and drained well
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Spray a loaf tin with low-calorie cooking spray and line it with baking parchment.

Spray a large frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray and sauté the carrots, onion and courgette over a medium-high heat. As they cook, they will release some liquid. Keep cooking until this evaporates. It should take 8–9 minutes.
Add the thyme and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and continue cooking for another minute.

In a large mixing bowl, mash the chickpeas with a fork or potato masher. You can use a food processor if you wish but be careful not to over process. You want a rough, lumpy texture, not a smooth paste.
Add the cooked vegetables and then all the other ingredients, except the salt, pepper and egg, to the bowl.
Season with some salt and pepper if you wish.
When you are happy with the seasoning, mix in the egg then transfer to the prepared loaf tin, pressing it down firmly.
Place in the hot oven for 40 minutes, until it is firm and golden.
